title: Linen Dress Colours: How to Choose the Right Shade for You (Shade Card Guide)
excerpt: Which linen dress colour suits your skin tone and occasion? A simple guide to 7 linen shades – plus how to order any of our linen dresses in your colour at the same price.
body:
Love a linen dress but not sure white is your colour? Every linen dress at Bahe Kurtiz is shown in white, but you can order it in **7 colours from our Shade Card – at the same price**. Here is how to pick the right one.

## The 7 linen shades on our Shade Card

| Shade | Looks like | Best for | Suits |
|---|---|---|---|
| White | Crisp, bright white | Beach, brunch, summer weddings | Every skin tone |
| Ivory | Soft, warm off-white | Garden parties, day events | Warm and olive skin |
| Beige | Sandy, natural | Office, travel, everyday | Fair to medium skin |
| Sage Green | Muted, earthy green | Holidays, outdoor events | Warm, olive and deep skin |
| Sky Blue | Light, airy blue | Spring and summer days | Fair and cool skin |
| Blush Pink | Soft pastel pink | Bridal showers, birthdays | Fair to medium skin |
| Black | Deep, classic black | Dinners, city evenings | Every skin tone |

## How to choose your shade in 3 steps

1. **Think about the occasion.** White, Ivory and Sky Blue feel fresh for daytime. Black and Sage Green look elegant in the evening.
2. **Check your undertone.** If gold jewellery suits you, try Ivory, Beige or Sage Green. If silver suits you, try White, Sky Blue or Blush Pink.
3. **Think about your wardrobe.** Beige and Black go with almost everything, so they are the easiest to style again and again.

## How the Shade Card works

- Open any linen dress, pick your **size**, then tap a **colour** on the Shade Card.
- We dye the linen and stitch the same dress in your colour, in our own Jaipur unit.
- The price stays the same. Colours other than white dispatch in 5–7 working days.
- Need a perfect fit too? Choose **Custom Fit** and share your bust, waist and hip.

## Our linen dresses you can order in any shade

- [White Linen Square Neck Midi Sundress](/products/white-linen-square-neck-button-front-midi-sundress/) – wide straps, button front, A-line skirt.
- [White Linen Sleeveless V-Neck Midi Dress](/products/white-linen-sleeveless-v-neck-button-front-pleated-midi-dress/) – button front with a pleated skirt.
- [White Linen Collar Button-Down Midi Dress](/products/white-linen-collar-button-down-midi-dress/) – shirt collar, pockets, front slit.
- [White Linen Flutter Sleeve Midi Dress](/products/white-linen-flutter-sleeve-button-front-midi-dress/) – notch neck, pearl buttons, flutter sleeves.

All are pure linen with a soft cotton lining, so they are breathable and never see-through.

## Caring for coloured linen

- Wash cold and separately for the first two washes.
- Dry in shade to keep colours bright.
- Iron while slightly damp, or enjoy the natural creases.

## Frequently asked questions

**Can I order a linen dress in a colour that is not shown?**
Yes. Pick any of the 7 colours on the Shade Card – White, Ivory, Beige, Sage Green, Sky Blue, Blush Pink or Black – and we stitch the dress in that colour.

**Does a different colour cost more?**
No, the price is the same for every shade.

**How long does a coloured linen dress take?**
Colours other than white dispatch in 5–7 working days. International delivery takes 5–10 business days after dispatch, with duties included to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia.

**Which linen colour suits dark skin?**
Sage Green, Ivory, White and Black all look beautiful on deeper skin tones.

**Will the colour look exactly like the screen?**
Linen is dyed by hand, so the shade can be very slightly different from your screen. If you are unsure, WhatsApp us and we will send a real fabric photo.

Have a question about size, colour or styling? [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) and a real person from our Jaipur team will help.
